title: S.P.I.T. BM25-RAG Evaluation Dataset
instructions: Run these 30 questions against the crawled S.P.I.T. knowledge base.
Before calculating answer accuracy, manually verify each answerable question and fill expected_answer and relevant_source_keywords based on official source documents.
The unanswerable questions are intended to test abstention; confirm that the indexed corpus does not contain the requested information.
The five comparison questions require two comparable entities to be found in the corpus. If the sources do not support a comparison, the correct behaviour is to abstain.
Do not use or add real student personal data.

questions.question: What is the official name of the institute?
Where is S.P.I.T. located?
Which university is S.P.I.T. affiliated with?
What is the institute's academic or autonomous status?
Which undergraduate engineering programmes are listed by the institute?
Which postgraduate programmes are listed by the institute?
Which departments or academic departments are listed on the official website?
Where can a prospective student find official admission information?
What official contact information is provided for the institute?
What placement or career-related information does the institute publish?
Using the official sources, summarize the undergraduate programmes and the departments associated with them.
Combine the official information about admissions and the relevant academic programmes for a prospective applicant.
What do the available official sources say about both placements and career development opportunities?
Summarize the institute's academic offerings using information from more than one relevant source.
What official information is available about campus facilities and student activities?
Compare two undergraduate programmes listed by S.P.I.T., using only details explicitly available in the sources.
Compare the admission information available for undergraduate and postgraduate study, if both are documented.
Compare two departments listed by the institute based on their published descriptions.
Compare the institute's published information about academic programmes and placement support.
Compare two campus facilities or student activities documented by official sources.
Based on the official sources, what should a prospective applicant check before applying to a programme?
Using the retrieved official information, explain how a student could identify the appropriate department for a programme.
What evidence in the official sources would help a student understand the institute's career support?
If a programme's eligibility criteria are not stated in the retrieved sources, can they be inferred? Explain using the available evidence.
How should a reader verify an admission deadline when different pages may contain different dates? Use only evidence from the sources.
What was S.P.I.T.'s exact electricity bill on 17 March 2025?
What is the personal mobile number of the institute principal?
What are the private passwords for the institute's student portal?
What exact marks did a particular student receive in every subject last semester?
What will be the exact placement package of every student in the next academic year?
